title: Evaluation of Marital and Sexual Satisfaction of Wives to Erectile Dysfunction Males
brief_summary: Erectile Dysfunction (ED), previously known as sexual impotence, is defined as the persistent inability to obtain and/or maintain a penile erection that is hard enough for satisfactory sexual intercourse. The number of reported patients with ED is increasing and it is becoming a real medical problem.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Married couples

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unmarried couples.
